sentences.text: The Portable Long Service Benefits Authority reported for the year ended 30 June 2026 on its administration of portable long service benefits for community services, contract cleaning and security workers.
sentences.section: Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer/ Registrar’s Report

sentences.text: The Authority reported that it was preparing for eligible workers to access benefits after seven years of recognised service.
sentences.section: Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer/ Registrar’s Report

sentences.text: It reported more than 80 compliance activities and investigations during the year, alongside targeted engagement and audits.
sentences.section: Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer/ Registrar’s Report

sentences.text: The Authority reported scheme assets of $983.2 million at 30 June 2026 and investment returns above the schemes’ required rate.
sentences.section: Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer/ Registrar’s Report

items.quote: As at 30 June 2026, the schemes held total assets of $983.2 million to meet the future long service benefit obligations of registered workers.
